title: Label 5,000 product images by category
instructions:
# Batch 07

Images: https://example.com/batch-07.zip

One CSV row per image: `filename,category`.
Categories come from "categories.txt"; use the path C:\data\out.csv if you are on Windows.
	Café and crème brûlée photos go under "food".
accepted_when: CSV has 5,000 rows and no empty category
I will spot-check 100 rows; 97 or more must be right 👍
